market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Estimates vary by scope: general titanium casting ~$3.5B (2023) at 6.5%/yr; aerospace titanium specifically: $4.1-4.5B (2022-2025) to $4-7B by 2030-2035, CAGR 5.3-9.0%/yr depending on source.
exportGeographies: North America and Europe (OEM-driven, via Safran/GE-linked programs) — no aggregated export dataset found
globalCompetitors: Precision Castparts (Berkshire Hathaway) — FY2024 revenue $10.4B, committed >$628M in capacity investment including a $500M titanium melt facility in West Virginia
market.domesticSlice: not separately sized; India's defense/aerospace indigenization push ('Make in India') is the explicit domestic policy driver

structureFacts: Global titanium-melt capacity squeeze tied to Boeing/Airbus production ramps — Precision Castparts' new melt facility investment is direct evidence of this

NADCAP accreditation lets OEMs/Tier-1s fast-track supplier audits, cutting weeks-to-months out of new-supplier qualification timelines — a pre-validated process-control credential accepted across all subscribing prime contractors

adoptionStructure.note: Long-term supply agreements won through multi-year OEM/Tier-1 sourcing programs, often single- or dual-sourced once qualified, creating high switching costs and revenue visibility — not a repurchase-rate category

peers.name: MTAR Technologies
peers.note: exotic-metallurgy incl. titanium, precision manufacturing — a comparable peer though not pure aerospace-titanium-casting

peers.name: Azad Engineering
peers.note: ROE/ROCE fell YoY attributed to heavy capacity capex — airfoils/blades/vanes for jet engines and gas turbines

drivers: AS9100 (aerospace QMS) — effectively mandatory for OEM/prime-contractor supplier status
NADCAP accreditation for safety-critical special processes (welding, heat treat, NDT) — required by Boeing D1-9000, Airbus, Safran supplier-qualification procedures

steps: offer investment-cast and forged titanium/superalloy structural and rotating components
serve aero-engine, airframe, and defense/industrial applications
win named OEM programs (e.g. LEAP engine casting parts)
operate vacuum arc remelting (VAR)/vacuum induction melting (VIM)/plasma arc melting for alloy purity
precision investment-casting and open-die forging process control
maintain NADCAP-accredited special processes and AS9100 quality systems
scale melt-furnace throughput, casting cell capacity, forging press tonnage
match capacity to OEM production-rate ramps
deliver on-time to OEM production schedules
collaborate on castability/design-for-manufacture during qualification and PPAP
win long-term supply agreements through multi-year OEM/Tier-1 sourcing programs
become single- or dual-sourced once qualified
